title: Normalized blogroll model (reader-side parse of blogroll.opml)
description: Standard OPML 2.0 with no extensions (spec 11). The blogroll is curated and claims no completeness; readers and crawlers MUST NOT treat it as everything the publisher follows.

htmlUrl.description: Its origin, or page URL for a legacy feed.

notes: No blyg-specific OPML attributes exist; the feed's <blyg:manifest> supplies blyg upgrade on resolve (spec 11, 12.1).
A blyg with nothing to show serves no blogroll.opml (404) and omits the manifest key (spec 11).
